description: Header file defining the Blit9 class for surface copy utilities in Direct3D 9 rendering within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: Blit9
classes.description: A utility class for surface copying and format conversion in Direct3D 9 within ANGLE.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Blit9 object with the given renderer context.

methods.name: copy2D
methods.description: Copies a 2D surface region to a destination with specified format and offset.

methods.name: copyCube
methods.description: Copies a cube map face to a destination with specified format and offset.

methods.name: copyTexture
methods.description: Copies a texture region to a destination with format conversion and optional flipping/premultiplied alpha.

methods.name: boxFilter
methods.description: Performs a 2x2 box filter sampling from source to destination surfaces.

methods.name: formatConvert
methods.description: Converts the format of a texture or surface, applying shaders as needed.

methods.name: setFormatConvertShaders
methods.description: Sets shaders used for format conversion.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies from source surface or texture to destination surface.

methods.name: copySurfaceToTexture
methods.description: Creates a texture from a surface.

methods.name: setVertexShader
methods.description: Sets the vertex shader for blitting operations.

methods.name: setPixelShader
methods.description: Sets the pixel shader for blitting operations.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Executes the rendering of the current blit operation.

methods.name: restoreState
methods.description: Restores the previously saved Direct3D state.
